title: Розгляд пропозиції та рішення
fields_and_relations: До/після, base revision, докази, scope, decision/reason і конкретний результат.
required_interaction: Accept/reject/correct/defer; stale base блокує apply; автор пропозиції не отримує reviewer grant.

implementation.view_model: WF-08 unified queue for identities, authority matches, typed relations, classifications, description proposals and exact catalog handoffs; evidence/counterevidence, accept/correct/reject/unresolved/disputed, stale comparison, repeated review and immutable applications
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store; lazy WF-08 tables preserve existing records.
permissions: Separate scoped review.write, publication.write and access.manage grants
Applying description changes also requires catalog.write
Navigation and demo account choice do not change permission assignments
implementation.atomicity: Review, exact result revision, evidence, verification and application commit together. Deferred review retains a task. Source changes invalidate linked effective policies and withdraw affected publications. Revocation withdraws linked publications in the same transaction.
limitations: Browser-local prototype; no automatic entity merge, remote authority service or external evidence retrieval.
Controlled D13 predicate subset; specialist folklore relations and conflicting typed person facts still need dedicated domain work.
Rights approval and publication readiness remain WF-09; machine text review uses the existing dedicated text workflow.
implementation.research_feedback: research-feedback/1: exact frozen assertion/evidence, before/after, reasoned accept/correct/reject/defer, explicit confirmation; O43/O44/application; catalog.write required for changes; stale or unavailable basis blocks application.
